text:
maria_cs: heads up — OmniOps just told Jamie they'd like to stand up 3 new teams on our API next quarter. asking for embedding throughput + private VPC for logs.
jamie_ae: confirmed on call earlier. renewal in 45 days, they'd like dedicated capacity estimate and onboarding timeline.
sam_se: from SE POV, big asks: multi-tenant isolation, CRM webhook ingestion, 50 req/s sustained per team, spike to 200/s. Also want dev environment in their VPC.
nia_onboard: recommend 2-week enablement per team + 1-week integration support. Need docs + runbook. Can we get a staging cluster?
leo_sre: staging cluster OK but need security checklist. KMS + audit logs required. pinging eng-infra for help.
maria_cs: risk flag: renewal churn if we can't show cost + latency plan by EOW — they explicitly said "can't justify spend w/o numbers".
jamie_ae: action: can we get ballpark cost for Dedicated + VPC + burst capacity? Q: Is auto-burst metered separately?
sam_se: yes it's metered. ballpark: Dedicated base + burst estimate depends on quantization and batching. I'll run perf baseline w/ current model family.
eng-bot: new ticket created: CS-3124 — OmniOps expansion: Dedicated estimate + onboarding plan. Assigned to @sam_se and @leo_sre.
leo_sre: I'll scope network requirements. Need contact from their infra. maria, can you share contact + any SOC2/ISO docs they need?
maria_cs: added notes: they require SOC2 Type II evidence + weekly latency report. Contact: oliver@omniops.com (infra lead).
jamie_ae: I'll loop in finance for pricing worksheet. we should propose two options: 1) reserved capacity (lower unit cost) 2) pay-as-you-go with burst.
sam_se: starting perf run now. ETA 48h. Will include sequence length distribution and token cost estimates. Also will run KV cache sims for their chat-heavy workload.
nia_onboard: enablement plan draft: Week0 kick-off, Week1 infra + keys, Week2 model integration, Week3 QA + cutover. Add one training day per team.
maria_cs: capture feedback: they mentioned hallucination hits on long transcripts. Need to link to product for evaluation thresholds.
sam_se: note: may recommend light quantization + 8-bit kernels to reduce cost; quality holdouts will be validated by eval set.
jamie_ae: risk mitigation: can we propose a canary rollout (1 team) before full expansion? suggests 2-week canary with SLA check.
leo_sre: agree. canary will exercise VPC egress rules and auditing.
maria_cs: next steps: sam runs perf, leo scopes network, jamie prepares pricing, nia prepares enablement draft. Check-in in 48h.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: CS check-in for OmniOps in 48 hours (thread CS-3124).
jamie_ae: thanks — I'll also ask legal for data processing addendum template.
maria_cs: sgtm. logging this in Salesforce opp: OPP-8891. tagging renewal_date=1720461543 (45 days).
sam_se: uploading perf notes to the thread once ready.
leo_sre: if eng-infra needs to be added, I'll DM them.
maria_cs: great work team :thumbsup:
